title: QASP: Query-Adaptive Robust Vector Search Policy
abstract: arXiv:2607.29606v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A fundamental challenge of vector search is achieving consistently high recall while minimizing computational costs. Fixed search parameters cause significant performance variance across queries, and conventional evaluation on average recall masks these per-query disparities. We introduce QASP (Query-Adaptive robust vector Search Policy), which predicts the complete recall progression curve per query via a single upfront supervised regression, from which a search policy is derived for any recall target; this avoids iterative model invocations during search or separate predictors per target. By predicting normalized recall values with scale-invariant features and pre-search inference, QASP generalizes across recall targets, index configurations, and datasets. The fine-grained progress predictions further enable a lightweight reactive complement that adjusts search depth based on predicted-versus-observed deviations without addit

translated_title: QASP：查询自适应的鲁棒向量搜索策略
translated_abstract: 向量搜索的一个根本挑战是在最小化计算成本的同时实现持续的高召回率。固定的搜索参数会导致不同查询之间显著的性能差异，而传统的基于平均召回率的评估方式掩盖了这些逐查询的差异。我们提出了QASP（查询自适应鲁棒向量搜索策略），它通过一次预先的监督回归预测每个查询的完整召回率进展曲线，并据此为任意召回率目标推导出搜索策略；这避免了搜索过程中的迭代模型调用，也无需为每个目标单独设置预测器。通过利用尺度不变特征进行搜索前推理来预测归一化召回率值，QASP能够跨召回率目标、索引配置和数据集进行泛化。细粒度的进展预测还进一步支持一种轻量级的反应式补充机制，可根据预测值与观测值之间的偏差调整搜索深度，而无需额外的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: QASP通过单次预先监督回归预测每个查询的完整召回率进展曲线，从而为任意召回率目标推导出自适应搜索策略，在跨目标、索引配置和数据集泛化的同时兼顾高召回率与低计算成本。
en_tdlr: QASP predicts each query's complete recall progression curve via a single upfront supervised regression, deriving adaptive search policies for any recall target that generalize across targets, index configurations, and datasets while balancing high recall with low computational cost.
